text: <small>בשני ובחמישי ושאר ימים שמוציאין ספר תורה אומרים יהללו כשמחזירים הס"ת למקומו. ואומר החזן:</small>
קהל: הוֹדוֹ עַל־אֶֽרֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם: וַיָּֽרֶם קֶֽרֶן לְעַמּוֹ תְּהִלָּה לְכָל־חֲסִידָיו לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַם קְרֹבוֹ הַלְ֒לוּיָהּ:

versions.versionTitle: Translation based on the Metsudah linear siddur, by Avrohom Davis, 1981
text: On Mondays, Thursdays and other days when the Torah is read, as the Sefer Torah is returned to the Ark the Chazzan takes the Torah and says:
They will praise the Name of Adonoy for His Name alone is exalted.

Chazzan and congregation: His majesty is over the earth and the skies. He will raise the might of His people, [which is] praise for all His pious ones, for the children of Israel, the people near to Him. Praise God.
